name: Orbital Strike
text: 1 adversary troop lands here and stays (it doesn't march) until removed. The adversary gains 3 compute. Sway 2 toward Discord.

name: Commandeer
text: 1 adversary troop lands here and stands until removed. The adversary gains 3 compute. Each player near it pays 2 energy or discards 2 cards.

name: Supply Raid
text: 1 adversary troop lands here and stands until removed. The adversary gains 3 compute. Each player near it loses 2 energy.

name: Eviction
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here. The adversary gains 3 compute. Each player near it loses an ambassador.

name: Call-Up
text: 1 adversary troop lands here and stands until removed. This base makes 1 extra corp troop now, past its cap. The adversary gains 3 compute.

name: Agitators
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here. The adversary gains 3 compute. Sway 2 toward Discord.

name: Defection
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here. The adversary gains 3 compute. Each player near it loses an ambassador. Sway 1 toward Discord.

name: Smear Campaign
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here. The adversary gains 3 compute. Each player near it gets 3 less insight next round. Remove 1 Unity from the Unity track.

name: Propaganda Blitz
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here. The adversary gains 3 compute. Sway 2 toward Discord. Each player near it discards a card.

name: Border Provocation
text: 1 adversary troop lands here and stands until removed. The adversary gains 3 compute. Deal 1 extra tier-1 threat in this country; it executes next round.

name: Sabotage
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here. The adversary gains 3 compute. Each player near it loses 3 tokens from their cards.

name: Insider Access
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here and 1 on each of its country's 2 lowest-numbered player stations. The adversary gains 3 compute.

name: Wiper Malware
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here. The adversary gains 3 compute. Each player near it discards 2 cards or gets 2 less insight next round.

name: Cryptojacking
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here. The adversary gains 3 compute. Each player near it loses 1 research cube; for each who has none, 4 more compute.

name: Backdoor
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here. The adversary gains 3 compute, then 1 compute on every visible project.

name: Requisition
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here. The adversary gains 3 compute. Each player near it discards 2 cards or pays 3 chips.

name: Shakedown
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here. The player near it with the most credits (ties: lowest seat) loses 4 chips. The adversary gains 4 compute.

name: Embargo
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here. Sites on or next to it can't be claimed next round. The adversary gains 3 compute.

name: Credit Crunch
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here. The adversary gains 3 compute. Each player near it turns 1 building face down until the end of next round.

name: Chip Shortage
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here. The adversary gains 3 compute. Each player near it loses 3 chips or discards 2 cards.

name: Blackout
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here. The adversary gains 3 compute. Cities on or next to it produce no energy next round.

name: Load Shedding
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here. The adversary gains 3 compute. Players near it can't use Actions that cost energy next round.

name: Power Surcharge
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here. The adversary gains 3 compute. Each player near it loses 2 energy or discards 2 cards.

name: Cooling Failure
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here. The adversary gains 3 compute. Each player near it makes no research cubes next round.

name: Grid Tap
text: Create 1 adversary ambassador here. The player near it with the most credits (ties: lowest seat) loses 2 energy. The adversary gains 4 compute.

name: Total War
text: 3 troops land on the base here and march at once. Each player near it destroys 1 of their nodes near it (never their last).

name: Siege
text: The factory here is destroyed with the nodes on its hex (never a last node). 2 troops land here and stay.

name: Manhunt
text: Each player near it loses 2 ambassadors. 1 troop lands here.

name: Conscription
text: For 3 rounds, the corp base here makes 1 extra troop each round, even past its cap. Remove 2 Unity from the Unity track.

name: Casus Belli
text: 2 troops land on the base here. Next round, the fronts next to it fight twice. Sway 2 toward Discord.

name: Overrun
text: Create 3 adversary ambassadors here. Corrupt cities (1 fewer).

name: Insurrection
text: Create 3 adversary ambassadors here. Remove 2 Unity from the Unity track. Sway 1 toward Discord.

name: Deepfake Wave
text: Sway 2 toward Discord. Remove 2 Unity from the Unity track. Each player near it gets 3 less insight next round.

name: Turncoats
text: In its country: create 2 adversary ambassadors on each of the 2 lowest-numbered player factories. Each player near it loses 2 ambassadors.

name: Propaganda Ministry
text: In its country: create 1 adversary ambassador on each of the 2 lowest-numbered clean cities. Corrupt cities (1 fewer). Sway 2 toward Discord.

name: Station Seizure
text: The station here is corrupted, even a player's. The adversary gains 4 compute.

name: Sleeper Cells
text: A botnet lands on the station here (else the nearest piece without one). Create 2 adversary ambassadors here.

name: Purge Protocols
text: Each player near it discards their most expensive card in hand, loses 3 tokens from their cards and destroys 1 node near it (never their last).

name: Data Breach
text: Each player near it loses 2 research cubes and gets 3 less insight next round. The adversary gains 5 compute.

name: Zero Day
text: The adversary gains 8 compute. Each player near it turns 1 of their buildings face down until the end of next round (tags still count).

name: Asset Freeze
text: Each player near it turns 2 of their buildings face down until the end of next round (tags still count) and discards 2 cards.

name: Mass Production
text: The adversary builds a factory on the free industrial zone nearest this threat's token. The adversary gains 5 compute.

name: Factory Occupation
text: The adversary gains 4 compute. 1 troop lands on the factory or zone here and stays: a factory makes nothing while it stands; a zone gives 4 more compute.

name: Skimming Operation
text: Each player near it gets 4 less chips income next round. The adversary gains 5 compute.

name: Trade Blockade
text: Create 3 adversary ambassadors here. Sites on or next to it can't be claimed for 2 rounds.

name: Grid Collapse
text: Cities on or next to it produce no energy for 2 rounds. Each player near it destroys 1 of their nodes near it (never their last).

name: Power Rationing
text: Each player near it loses 3 energy and turns 1 of their buildings face down until the end of next round (tags still count).

name: Thermal Runaway
text: Stations on or next to it make no research cubes for 2 rounds. Each player near it gets 3 less insight next round. The adversary gains 4 compute.

name: Dark Cities
text: In its country: create 1 adversary ambassador on each of the 3 lowest-numbered cities on or next to it. Remove 2 Unity from the Unity track.

name: Overload
text: Each player near it destroys 1 of their nodes near it (never their last). The adversary gains 5 compute.

name: Garrison State
text: In its country: create 3 adversary ambassadors on the lowest-numbered city on or next to it. 2 troops land on the base here.

name: Shock Doctrine
text: Each player near it loses 1 ambassador. Remove 2 Unity from the Unity track. Sway 2 toward Discord.

name: Full Spectrum Assault
text: A botnet lands on the station here (else the nearest piece without one). Deal 1 extra tier-1 threat in this country. The adversary gains 4 compute.

name: Last Ultimatum
text: Each player near it destroys 1 of their nodes near it (never their last) and loses an ambassador. Deal 1 extra tier-2 threat here; it executes next round.

name: Capital Siphon
text: The adversary gains 6 compute. Each player near it discards 2 cards and loses 2 tokens from their cards.

name: Iron Curtain
text: 2 troops land on the factory or zone here. Each player near it loses 2 energy. Remove 3 Unity from the Unity track.

name: Spearhead
text: 4 troops land on the base here and march at once, 2 steps. Each player near it destroys 1 of their nodes near it (never their last).

name: Scorched Earth
text: The factory here is destroyed with the nodes on its hex (never their last); on an empty zone, 3 troops land instead. Each player near it loses 3 energy.

name: General Mobilization
text: Next round, the fronts next to this base fight twice. Its corp makes 3 more troops now, past its cap; 2 troops land here. Sway 2 toward Discord.

name: War Economy
text: An adversary factory lands on the zone here, else the nearest free zone, with 2 troops on it. The adversary gains 5 compute.

name: Regime Change
text: The city here is corrupted, with the nodes on and next to it (never their last). Each player near it loses an ambassador. Remove 2 Unity from the Unity track.

name: Lab Takeover
text: The station here is corrupted, even a player's; the adversary gains 6 compute. Each player near it gets 4 less insight next round.

name: Hostile Takeover
text: The adversary seizes the factory here, even a player's; on an empty zone, it builds one there. Each player near it loses 4 chips. The adversary gains 5 compute.

name: Cascade Failure
text: A botnet lands on the station here, else the nearest piece without one. Next round, cities and stations on or next to it produce nothing. Each player near it loses 3 energy.
